title.es: Dos tiempos en una misma oración

es: Formar condicionales mixtos en las dos direcciones y usar la inversión Had I… y If it weren't for…

teaching.en: If I had saved more money, I would be able to buy a car now.
teaching.es: Si hubiera ahorrado más dinero, ahora podría comprar un coche.
teaching.explanationEs: 3 → 2: condición pasada (had saved) y resultado presente (would be able to).
segments: If I had saved more money, I would
be able to buy a car now.
teaching.audioText: If I had saved more money, I would be able to buy a car now.

teaching.en: If I were taller, I would have joined the football team last year.
teaching.es: Si fuera más alto, me habría unido al equipo de fútbol el año pasado.
teaching.explanationEs: 2 → 3: un rasgo de hoy (were) explica un resultado pasado (would have joined).
segments: If I were taller, I would have
joined the football team last year.
teaching.audioText: If I were taller, I would have joined the football team last year.

teaching.en: If it weren't for the rain, we would be at the beach now.
teaching.es: De no ser por la lluvia, ahora estaríamos en la playa.
teaching.explanationEs: If it weren't for + nombre = «de no ser por» (hoy).
segments: If it weren't for the rain, we
would be at the beach now.
teaching.audioText: If it weren't for the rain, we would be at the beach now.

teaching.en: If it weren't for my brother, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
teaching.es: De no ser por mi hermano, no habría aprobado el examen.
teaching.explanationEs: If it weren't for también puede explicar un resultado pasado.
segments: If it weren't for my brother,
I wouldn't have passed the exam.
teaching.audioText: If it weren't for my brother, I wouldn't have passed the exam.

teaching.en: Had I known about the exam, I would have studied harder.
teaching.es: De haberlo sabido, habría estudiado más.
teaching.explanationEs: Had I known = If I had known: inversión, sin if y con had delante del sujeto.
segments: Had I known about the exam,
teaching.audioText: Had I known about the exam, I would have studied harder.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une el rasgo de hoy de Sam con lo que no pasó el año pasado.

choices.text: If Sam had been taller, he would join the team.
If Sam is taller, he would have joined the team.
If Sam were taller, he would have joined the team.

feedback.es: Sam es bajo hoy (2) y no se unió el año pasado (3): If + were, would have + participio.

hint.es: Un rasgo de hoy explica algo que no pasó antes: if + pasado, would have + participio.

origin.text: Sam is short. He didn't join the football team last year.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si yo fuera más fuerte, habría ganado la carrera.»

feedback.es: Para el presente irreal se usa were, también con I: If I were stronger.

hint.es: Es la forma de be que sigue a if en el presente irreal.

origin.text: If I ___ stronger, I would have won the race.

prompt.es: Ordena la inversión: «De haberlo sabido, habría estudiado más.»

answer.text: Had I known, I would have studied more.

feedback.es: Hay que empezar con Had, sin if: Had I known equivale a If I had known.

hint.es: Empieza con el auxiliar had, sin if.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada condicional con su traducción.

pairs: If it weren't for the traffic, we would be home now.

pairs.es: De no ser por el tráfico, ahora estaríamos en casa.

pairs: Had I known, I would have called you.

pairs.es: De haberlo sabido, te habría llamado.

pairs: If he spoke French, he would have got the job.

pairs.es: Si hablara francés, habría conseguido el trabajo.

pairs: If I had saved more, I would be able to travel now.

pairs.es: Si hubiera ahorrado más, ahora podría viajar.

feedback.es: Cada forma combina dos tiempos: lo de hoy explica el pasado o lo pasado explica hoy.

pairs: If it weren't for the traffic, we would be home now.

pairs.es: De no ser por el tráfico, ahora estaríamos en casa.

pairs.es: De haberlo sabido, te habría llamado.

pairs: If he spoke French, he would have got the job.

prompt.es: Reescribe con inversión, sin if: «If I had known about the party, I would have come.»

answer.text: Had I known about the party, I would have come.
accepted: Had I known about the party, I would have come.
Had I known about the party I would have come.

feedback.es: La inversión quita if y pone had delante del sujeto: Had I known = If I had known.

origin.text: If I had known about the party, I would have come.

prompt.es: Completa: «De no ser por este trabajo, me habría ido al extranjero.»

feedback.es: «De no ser por» se dice If it weren't for + nombre: for va después de weren't.

origin.text: If it weren't ___ this job, I would have moved abroad.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si Leo hubiera practicado más, ahora estaría en el equipo.»

feedback.es: La condición pasada (had practised) pide un resultado presente con would + verbo base.

origin.text: If Leo had practised more, he ___ be in the team now.

prompt.es: Reescribe con «If it weren't for»: «Thanks to Leo's help, I passed the test.»

answer.text: If it weren't for Leo's help, I wouldn't have passed the test.
accepted: If it weren't for Leo's help, I wouldn't have passed the test.
If it weren't for Leo, I wouldn't have passed the test.

feedback.es: If it weren't for + nombre expresa «de no ser por» y el resultado pasado lleva wouldn't have + participio.

origin.text: Thanks to Leo's help, I passed the test.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase une el miedo actual de Mia con lo que no hizo el verano pasado?

choices.text: If Mia weren't afraid of water, she would have gone on the trip.
If Mia hadn't been afraid of water, she would go on the trip.
If Mia isn't afraid of water, she would have gone on the trip.

feedback.es: El miedo es de hoy (were) y el viaje fue en el pasado (would have gone): dirección 2 → 3.

origin.text: Mia is afraid of water. She didn't go on the boat trip last summer.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué lamenta el hablante.

choices.text: He did not study enough at school.
He has a good job now.

feedback.es: Lamenta no haberse esforzado en el colegio; por eso hoy no tiene un buen trabajo.

origin.audio: If I had worked harder at school, I would have a better job now.

prompt.es: Ordena: «De no ser por ti, ahora no estaríamos aquí.»

answer.text: If it weren't for you, we wouldn't be here now.

feedback.es: If it weren't for you = de no ser por ti; el resultado presente lleva wouldn't be.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la inversión correcta de «If I had seen the sign, I would have stopped»?

choices.text: Did I see the sign, I would have stopped.
Have I seen the sign, I would have stopped.
Had I seen the sign, I would have stopped.

feedback.es: La inversión mantiene el participio y mueve had al principio: Had I seen…

prompt.es: Completa: «Si hablara mejor inglés, habría conseguido el trabajo en Londres.»

feedback.es: Un rasgo de hoy (hablar mejor inglés) explica un resultado pasado: if + pasado simple, would have + participio.

origin.text: If he ___ better English, he would have got the job in London.
